integrity: Exact exhaustive enumeration with two separately implemented all-state checkers; independently externally audited evidence is not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Finite thirty-vertex Tutte–Coxeter incidence graph; no extension to all generalized quadrangles; previously known minimum resolving-set size is not claimed new; possible unindexed overlap with work on metric-basis reconfiguration.
title: Exact metric-basis reconfiguration of the Tutte–Coxeter graph under token jumping and sliding
